typography.guidelines: Minimum 16px font size for all essential content to ensure readability in sunlight. High contrast text against light backgrounds.

spacing_and_layout.bento_spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-4 to p-6 inside cards.

navigation.behavior: fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 bg-white border-t border-gray-200 pb-safe

cards.style: flat solid, rounded-xl, 1px border #E5E7EB, slight shadow-sm on hover

buttons.primary: bg-[#059669] text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-3 font-semibold w-full sm:w-auto text-base sm:text-lg hover:bg-[#047857] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#059669] border-2 border-[#059669] rounded-lg px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-base sm:text-lg hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors

weather_widget.style: gradient background (e.g., from-blue-50 to-green-50), bold temperature text, Lucide weather icons (Sun, Cloud), prominent current conditions with smaller 3-day forecast at bottom.

mandi_bhav.style: clean table or stack of cards on mobile. Distinct badges for Location and Crop. Highlight Min/Max prices with color-coding (e.g., red for down, green for up, or bold black for clarity).

government_schemes.style: blog-style list of cards. Image on top (or left on desktop), clear 'Scheme Name' in h3, 2-line 'Benefit' summary, primary CTA 'Apply Now'.

affiliate_products.style: 2-column grid on mobile, 3-column on desktop. High-quality product image, clean white background, clear price, 'Buy on Amazon' primary button.

monetization_ads.style: reserved placeholder divs with bg-gray-100, border-dashed border-2 border-gray-300, centered text 'AdSense Placeholder', fixed heights (e.g., h-24 for banner, h-64 for sidebar).

icons.usage: Use highly recognizable literal icons: Tractor for Mandi, Cloud/Sun for Weather, Leaf for Schemes, ShoppingCart for Store. Size: w-6 h-6 for tabs, w-8 h-8 for widgets.

image_urls.description: Farmer in a verdant field, establishing context.
Farmer with oxen in a lush green field.

media.logo_strategy: Use text-based logo with Lucide Sprout or Tractor icon next to it if no image logo provided.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-md on cards and buttons.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Always include focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#059669] focus:ring-offset-2 on interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure minimum text size is text-base (16px) for readability.
Implement language switcher (EN/HI/MR/PA) in the top header. You can mock the translations but keep the UI element.
Layout should primarily target mobile (max-w-md mx-auto for main content view on desktop, or standard responsive with bottom nav switching to side nav on desktop).
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
For the AdSense placeholders, use a distinct visual style (dashed border, gray background) so they are obvious but not disruptive.
Use lucide-react icons for the bottom tab bar: Home, Tractor (Mandi), Cloud (Weather), Store (Products).
